protocol.description: Paired causal ablation. All variants reuse the same model-derived rotation choice and image-derived global affine fit; only the nonlinear NDF residual and local NCC vary.
limitations: Affine-only still depends on the learned coarse matcher to choose rotation and estimate the image-derived affine map.
The learned multiscale spatial decoder is not implemented and is not represented by this experiment.
Oracle results are per-window analytic initializations and are not available at inference.
The images are generated at 3840 x 2160, but matching, affine prefit and local NCC use the 192 x 108 model raster; only the IC-GN solve uses the native-resolution images.
protocol.solver: WebGPU IC-GN, affine, 64 px subset and stride
